title: 第5章 健美圈传来噩耗第6章 卡系统的bug
slug: 人在美利坚我的叔叔堂吉诃德
content_zh:
【骑士之路：第一阶段，见习骑士】
【任务描述：真正的骑士不应在泥潭中安身立命。作为骑士侍从的冒险者，你也必须要向着真正的骑士进发。】
“等等，”李维挠了挠头，“我什么时候承认我是骑士侍从了？”
【骑士的磨砺：在14天内，将力量、敏捷、体质、精神四项数值全部提升至1.2，强健的体魄和美好的品德是成为骑士的必备要素。】
【阶段奖励1：达成任意一项数值，奖励金币*3】
【阶段奖励2：达成任意两项数值，奖励金币*7】
【阶段奖励3：全部达标，奖励金币*10，可以开启转职试炼】
“好吧，当我没说，”李维的眼睛亮了起来，“我接了！”
就哪怕抛开这个什么转职试炼不说，单单是20枚金币的奖励，就已经价值超过1万美金。
这笔钱足以让他脱离地下室，去租一个正常人类应该住的小公寓了。
李维不禁又看向了自己的面板。
【姓名：李维】
【年龄：17岁】
【力量：0.8】
【精神：1.0】
【敏捷：0.9】
【体质：0.9】
【技能：拙劣口才】
【装备：无】
【可分配属性点：0.1】

14天内全部属性提升到1.2，看起来也并不是难以完成，李维暗自想道，这些日子多去转转，触发一下任务或许就能完成了。
“也不知道能不能通过健身来提升这些属性？”李维看了看空荡荡的地下室，“我得去找个健身房了。”
说干就干，李维从自己的行李箱里拿了几件换洗的衣服，塞进包里就出了门。
尽管夜幕已经落下，纽约第8大道的人影逐渐稀疏，但是当李维跟着谷歌地图来到了最近一家健身房的时候，还是被美利坚的健身氛围所震惊。
这是一间在谷歌地图的评价上颇有好评的健身房，只不过里面并没有几个身穿瑜伽裤的美女，而是充斥着黑人、拉丁裔的纹身大汉、以及到处都是老旧的生锈器械。
在深夜10点的纽约布鲁克林区，健身房中依旧人声鼎沸，各种胳膊比李维腿粗的各色肌肉猛男们在铁馆内挥汗如雨。
李维的到来并没有引起任何人的注意，他来到健身房的前台，轻轻敲了敲台面。
前台坐着一个脖子比李维的大腿还粗的白人大汉，正百无聊赖地看着电视里的橄榄球比赛。
看到李维进来之后，他随意地撇了一眼：
“日卡15美金，月卡60美金，毛巾自备。”
说完之后，他上下打量了李维一眼：“私教课150美金一节，首次购买另外送一针外用睾酮和一针类固醇。”
“呃......谢谢，不用了，”李维婉拒了前台的变强套餐，递上了钱和自己的护照，“给我来一张月卡谢谢。”
“真不要？”白人前台一边低着头一边对着李维的护照进行登记，“你这样练很难出成绩的。”
“主要是可以突破人体极限，你知道吗？”他一边说一边坐着正展二头肌，暴起的青筋让李维都有些替他担心这些血管会不会在某一天爆开，“我在进入健身房之前也是像你一样，跟个小鸡仔一样，但是哥们，看看我现在。”
“卧推160公斤，深蹲270公斤，”他把找的40美金和护照、月卡递回给李维，“我也就练了5年，等你改主意了随时回来找我，我给你个优惠价。”
content_en:
[The Road of Knights: The First Stage, Apprentice Knight]
[Task description: A true knight should not live in the quagmire. As an adventurer of a knight's squire, you must also strive to become a real knight. 】
"Wait a minute," Levi scratched his head, "When did I admit that I was a knight's squire?"
[Knight’s training: within 14 days, increase all four values of strength, agility, physique, and spirit to 1.2. A strong body and good moral character are the necessary elements to become a knight. 】
[Stage Reward 1: If you achieve any value, you will be rewarded with 3 gold coins]
[Stage Reward 2: If you achieve any two values, you will be rewarded with 7 gold coins]
[Stage Reward 3: All standards are met, reward gold coins*10, and you can start the job transfer trial]
"Okay, pretend I didn't say it," Levi's eyes lit up, "I took it!"
Even leaving aside the job transfer trial, the reward of 20 gold coins alone is already worth more than 10,000 US dollars.
The money was enough to get him out of the basement and rent a small apartment where a normal human being would live.
Levi couldn't help but look at his panel again.
[Name: Li Wei]
[Age: 17 years old]
【Power: 0.8】
【Spirit: 1.0】
[Agility: 0.9]
[Physique: 0.9]
[Skill: Poor Eloquence]
[Equipment: None]
[Available attribute points: 0.1]
Raising all attributes to 1.2 within 14 days does not seem to be difficult to complete. Li Wei secretly thought to himself that if he wandered around more these days, he might be able to complete the task by triggering it.
"I wonder if I can improve these attributes through fitness?" Levi looked at the empty basement, "I have to find a gym."
Just as he said, Levi took a few changes of clothes from his suitcase, stuffed them into his bag and went out.
Although night had fallen and the crowds on 8th Avenue in New York were gradually sparse, when Levi followed Google Maps to the nearest gym, he was still shocked by the American fitness atmosphere.
This is a gym with good reviews on Google Maps, but there are not a few beauties in yoga pants. Instead, it is full of black and Latino men with tattoos, and old and rusty equipment everywhere.
At 10 o'clock in the evening in Brooklyn, New York, the gym was still bustling with people. Muscular men of all colors with arms thicker than Levi's legs were sweating profusely in the gym.
Levi's arrival did not attract anyone's attention. He came to the front desk of the gym and lightly knocked on the table.
Sitting at the front desk was a big white man with a neck thicker than Levi's thighs, boredly watching the football game on TV.
After seeing Levi come in, he glanced casually:
"The daily pass is US$15, the monthly pass is US$60, and you can bring your own towels."
After finishing speaking, he looked Levi up and down: "Private lessons are 150 US dollars per session, and for the first time you purchase, you will get an injection of topical testosterone and an injection of steroids."
"Uh...thank you, no need," Levi declined the power-up package at the front desk and handed over the money and his passport, "Give me a monthly pass, thank you."
"You really don't want to?" The white receptionist lowered his head while registering Levi's passport. "It's hard to get results if you practice like this."
"The main thing is that it can break the limits of the human body, you know?" He said while sitting and flexing his biceps. The bulging veins made Levi worried about whether these blood vessels would burst one day. "I was like you before I entered the gym, just like a chicken, but brother, look at me now."
"Bench press 160 kilograms, squat 270 kilograms." He handed the 40 US dollars, passport, and monthly card back to Levi. "I have only been practicing for 5 years. If you change your mind, come back to me at any time and I will give you a preferential price."
